root_causes.cause: Wrapper's SQL 'Holt' dispatched to HoltLinearTrend::auto() (SSE objective, trend seeded from a single first difference) instead of ETS(A,A,N), R holt()'s actual definition; the R-faithful ETS(A,A,N) construction cuts the point deviation 6.86x on AirPassengers and 13.41x on rw, and brings trend into the parity tier (3.01x cut).
root_causes.evidence: E4 mapping check (diagnosis/harness-output.txt): air HoltLinearTrend point_dev=1.155e-1 interval_dev=2.312e-1 -> ETS(A,A,N) R-faithful point_dev=1.684e-2 interval_dev=3.334e-2 (cut 6.86x); rw HoltLinearTrend point_dev=7.517e-2 interval_dev=3.262e-1 -> ETS(A,A,N) R-faithful point_dev=5.604e-3 interval_dev=1.960e-2 (cut 13.41x); trend HoltLinearTrend point_dev=1.653e-3 interval_dev=2.483e-1 -> ETS(A,A,N) R-faithful point_dev=5.495e-4 interval_dev=6.532e-3 (cut 3.01x, parity tier).
root_causes.resolution: fixed: forecast() dispatch and build_forecaster remapped SQL 'Holt' from HoltLinearTrend::auto() to ETS::new(ETSSpec::aan(), 1), matching R's holt() definition; model_name stays 'Holt' (17-03 Task 1).

root_causes.cause: At R's own fitted parameters the crate's ETS recursion, likelihood and bounds agree with R to floating-point precision (E5); the residual gap is R's own Nelder-Mead optimiser stopping at an inferior, in-bounds local optimum relative to the crate's own optimiser on the identical objective (E6).
root_causes.evidence: E5 (diagnosis/harness-output.txt): loglik_rel_dev <= 8.3e-16, point_rel_dev <= 1.4e-15 on every check in this row (bit-identical recursion). E6: air/holt crate_loglik=-863.582556 > r_loglik=-863.647300 (gap 0.0647); rw/holt crate_loglik=-515.765392 > r_loglik=-516.366200 (gap 0.6008); air/hw_additive & air/ets_AAA crate_loglik=-718.500709 > r_loglik=-765.935848 (gap 47.44); air/ets_MAM & air/hw_multiplicative crate_loglik=-681.105288 > r_loglik=-682.403619 / -685.827096 (gap 1.30 / 4.72); in every case the crate's own parameters stay within R's documented bounds (alpha/beta/gamma in [1e-4,0.9999], beta<=alpha, gamma<=1-alpha).
root_causes.resolution: known gap: the crate reaches a better-scoring, in-bounds optimum than R on these AirPassengers / rw fits; nothing to fix extension- or crate-side (R itself is the looser optimum).

root_causes.cause: AutoETS's model pool selects ETS(M,A,M) instead of R's ETS(M,Ad,M) because the crate's own optimiser, at R's selected (M,Ad,M) spec, reaches a worse log-likelihood than R under the same objective -- the crate's Nelder-Mead multi-start misses an optimum R's optimiser finds.
root_causes.evidence: E7 (diagnosis/harness-output.txt): crate_aicc=1409.4003 vs r_aicc=1400.6384 for MAdM (diff +8.76, worse), while crate_aicc=1401.0677 for MAM beats r_aicc=1403.6644 for the same spec. E6 at R's (M,Ad,M) parameters: crate_loglik=-683.964133 < r_loglik=-679.583216 (gap -4.3809, crate strictly worse under its own objective), with alpha=0.8024 beta=0.0197 gamma=0.1976 phi=0.98 all inside R's bounds. Reproduced standalone in repro_rc_03 (r_parity_diagnosis.rs).
root_causes.resolution: known gap: upstream optimiser issue, drafted.

root_causes.cause: SimpleExponentialSmoothing::auto() on the zero-inflated intermittent series converges to a different (alpha, l0) optimum than R's ses(): the crate's own optimiser, evaluated at R's fitted parameters, finds a strictly better log-likelihood than its own converged fit, so the crate's optimiser is missing an optimum its own objective scores higher.
root_causes.evidence: E5 at R's params (alpha=0.0001, l0=1.2417): loglik_rel_dev=0.000e0, point_rel_dev=6.437e-15 (bit-identical recursion/likelihood formula). E6: crate's own fit alpha=0.139114 l0 fixed to values[0]=4 gives crate_loglik=-380.625612, which is WORSE than r_loglik=-374.538408 at R's own parameters (gap -6.087205), so the crate's optimiser converges to a lower-likelihood point than one it can itself evaluate as better. Reproduced standalone in repro_rc_04 (r_parity_diagnosis.rs).
root_causes.resolution: known gap: upstream optimiser issue (likely the crate's fixed-l0-to-first-observation heuristic for SES on intermittent/zero-inflated series), drafted.

root_causes.cause: SARIMA prediction variance differs from R stats::arima KalmanForecast: at R's exact selected order (2,1,1)(0,1,0)[12], explicit ARIMA construction reproduces R's point forecast (rel dev 6.9e-3) but its 95% half-widths are systematically narrower than R's state-space prediction-error variance, especially at longer horizons.
root_causes.evidence: D-15 Miss E8 (diagnosis/harness-output.txt, autoarima_air_explicit_arima_e8_probe): explicit ARIMA(2,1,1)(0,1,0)[12] at R's order gives point_dev=6.883204e-3, interval_dev=2.489813e-1, with crate/R half-width ratio falling from 1.040 (h=1) to 0.818 (h=6) and recovering only to 0.879 (h=12) -- a systematic underestimate of multi-step SARIMA forecast variance, not a one-off numerical difference. E3 (autoarima_air_e3_timestamp_probe): synthetic-hourly and real-monthly timestamps give bit-identical intervals (same_bits=true), ruling out the wrapper's synthetic index as the cause. AutoARIMA's own selection path (autoarima_air_interval_e8_probe) matches the explicit-order call closely (point ratios near 1.0, interval ratios following the same h-dependent pattern), so this is an estimation/variance- formula difference, not a selection difference. Reproduced standalone in repro_rc_05 (r_parity_diagnosis.rs).
root_causes.resolution: known gap (user decision D-16, 2026-10-15): this is the ONE allowed AutoARIMA known gap; order identity and point forecasts remain hard parity on every series. Being fixed upstream in parallel (separate worktree/PR targeting anofox-forecast 0.16.2); the extension takes a follow-up bump to tighten this check once released.

tolerance.notes: closed_form_abs is exact (naive/snaive/rwf drift are closed-form); model_point_rel and interval_rel are parity targets for later phases (Phase 10 FCST-01, Phase 17 FCST-09), not asserted in Phase 9.

RandomWalkDrift is closed-form; bounds combine the z approximation with the crate's drift-interval formula, which differs slightly from R's rwf().
SimpleExponentialSmoothing::auto() on a non-intermittent series converges to R ses()'s optimum (contrast inter/ses, RC-04).
Same ETS(A,N,N) construction as SESOptimized above.
ETS(A,A,N) direct construction, R's own holt() definition; measured by diagnosis_report's trend/holt/Holt E4 block (the 'ETS(A,A,N) R-faithful' line).
